_about: Rewrite 2 P12. Which spec checks are scored by scripts/conformance.py (auto — no judgment, from the crawl and the page-text capture) and which the Opus audit agent fills (every check not listed under auto is judgment: claims, openings, FAQ fit, tone). Kept beside the specs, not inside them, so marking a check never changes a spec file or re-opens Paul's global specs approval.

auto.SVC-12: no planned city name in the H1 or any H2
auto.LOC-01: URL is one root slug (the city), no service (urlcheck rules)
auto.HUB-04: URL root-proximate, county or metro slug, no service (urlcheck rules)
auto.HUB-05: exactly one H1 and no brand
auto.COM-N: the Brand Guide phone number appears in the page text
auto.COM-W: word count recorded (for the judgment columns)
